artboards.title: Record Sources — the census line and ONE Inventory door per source (five states)
View sample — one document of a grouping, with the label set
Associate — recognition, AI suggestion, human decision
Inventory Information — a data system (kinds and fields)
Inventory Information — never censused: where the first census is started

annotations.text: DECIDED 2026-09-04 (three rounds) and drawn here: census runs PER SOURCE, one at a time, as a background job with progress · per-source Inventory Information (totals · readable / needs-OCR / unsupported · file types · identical groupings with counts + template status · linked types · last census + incremental diff) · documents = fingerprint groupings + layouts, data systems = kind enumeration + render recipes · embed tiers (kind description always · prose rows opt-in with cost · never pure id/date/number kinds) · field-REDACTED renderings are what embed · 'Identical Grouping' is the name (nav 'Find Same-Format Records' renamed in this build) · OCR-then-census for image files, as an opt-in with a visible cost · every file type counted, unreadables reported, never skipped. Kevin's 2026-09-13 add: a button to view a snapshot of an actual document / rendered record — drawn as 'View sample' and 'View a rendered record'.

FROM THE FLOW MAP (item 5, DESIGN_setup_flow_map.md), drawn on the assumption Kevin confirms it: the census needs NO record type linked (a bare drive can be censused); association happens over GROUPINGS, recognition first, then one AI naming call, and a HUMAN approval writes the type↔source link, the fingerprint stamps, the draft variant and the signature — nothing before. 'Find variants' on the Taxonomy page keeps its modal but reads this census store; the Scan source page (/discovery) retires. Sub-folders are walked; the folder path is shown as a hint under each grouping (decision 4), not used as a grouping rule.

DECIDED (Kevin, 2026-09-14 late): ONE 'Inventory' door per source card — the first census, its progress and every refresh live inside the Inventory screen (drawn: InventoryEmpty for a never-censused source; Refresh census on the censused ones). 'Everything else' is just a FILE LIST — no screen of its own (drawn expanded inline under the row). STILL OPEN: (c) 'Not needed' on a grouping — keep the Mass Redaction dismiss semantics (drawn) or hide the grouping entirely; (d) for search-only systems (Laserfiche) the card says plainly that no census is possible — acceptable until their APIs are wired? (e) OCR opt-in per source (drawn: one button for all 12) vs per grouping.

COST AND SAFETY, as drawn: the census itself is model-free (hashing, text extraction, fingerprinting) — the only paid steps are OCR (opt-in, priced) and one small naming call per unrecognised grouping at association time. Row-level embedding of a data kind is gated on its field template existing (sequence: census → field template → embed). Nothing on this screen releases a record; it is setup, gated like Record Sources today (System Admin / Director).
